description: Life sciences research LIMS, ISO 20387 biobanking (storage hierarchy, consent withdrawal blocking, freeze-thaw tracking), genomics/bioinformatics reproducibility manifests, and ICH E6(R3) clinical research EDC (eCRF, query lock, SAE, IP accountability, CDISC SDTM/CDASH/ADaM & OMOP CDM exports).
intendedDeveloperAudience: Biotech & Life Sciences R&D Engineering Teams
Clinical Trial EDC / CRO Engineering Teams
providedCapabilities: Research study/protocol registration, assay runs, reagent lots, and instrument QC logs
Biobank cryogenic hierarchy (Freezer/Rack/Box/Slot), aliquot genealogy, freeze-thaw counters, and consent-withdrawal release block
Genomics run metadata, FASTQ/BAM/VCF SHA-256 provenance, pipeline version & container digest tracking
Clinical trial pseudonymous enrollment, eConsent gate, eCRF query & PI e-signed database lock
Adverse event / SAE expedited flagging and Investigational Product (IP) witness-signed accountability
De-identified CDISC SDTM, CDASH/ADaM ADSL, and OMOP CDM v5.4 exports

relevantStandardsAndApplicability.scope: Technical support for biospecimen traceability, freeze-thaw logs, consent revocation gates
Technical support for eligibility/eConsent gates, query resolution before DB lock, SAE flagging, IP accountability

relevantStandardsAndApplicability.standard: CDISC SDTM / CDASH / ADaM & OMOP CDM 5.4

relevantStandardsAndApplicability.scope: Pipeline container digest and SHA-256 artifact manifests

knownLimitations: Bulk raw FASTQ/BAM sequencing payloads should reside in external object storage (S3/GCS/MinIO) referenced by SHA-256 URI.
GCP / ISO 20387 certification requires IRB/ethics governance and organizational quality management.
